reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Very light moisturizer with NO fragrance. Non-sticky and cooling. Perfect to wear under sunscreen and makeup. You;ll need something more moisturizing for nightime use, but for daytime wear it's perfect!
reviews.zh: 超輕身嘅保濕品，冇香料。唔黐笠，有涼感。配防曬同妝前用一流。夜晚用就需要再保濕啲嘅嘢，但日頭用就完美！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text:
I primarily used this product after applying my acne cream (Epiduo). It's the only moisturiser that doesn't sting my skin after applying the cream. I have extremely sensitive skin and couldn't bare even the simplest heluronic acid moisturiser on my skin wile using the acne treatment. This moisturiser leave my skin felling calm and refreshed. Lately it has become my go to moisturiser for morning and everything. The only slight downside is that it sometimes leaves my skin felling a bit sticky and might takea while to sink into my skin. It's good as a base before macup but, can be a little annoying if I go straight to bed after applying it 

The picture is of my skin ca 30min after applying and it's for the most part absorbed into my skin. It leaves my skin felling hydrated and has a slight cooling effect after applying.
reviews.zh:
我主要喺搽完暗瘡膏（Epiduo）之後用呢件產品。佢係唯一一款喺我用完暗瘡膏之後唔會拮住我塊面嘅保濕品。我皮膚極敏感，用緊暗瘡膏期間，連最基本嘅透明質酸保濕品都頂唔順。呢款保濕品用完之後皮膚會覺得平靜同清爽。最近佢已經成為我日頭嘅萬用保濕品。唯一嘅小缺點係有時用完皮膚會有少少黐笠感，而且要好耐先完全吸收。用嚟做妝前打底好好，但搽完直接瞓覺就會有少少煩

相片係搽完大約 30 分鐘後嘅皮膚狀態，大部分已經吸收晒。皮膚會覺得保濕，搽完之後有少少涼感。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Amazing product has quickly become a favorite. This and the beplain pore serum are miracle products. Together they do exactly as advertised. Shrunk my pores and gave me true glass skin. This does have a cooling effect, like when you use mints but it's not irritating.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品真係超讚，已經迅速成為我嘅最愛。佢同 beplain 毛孔精華一齊用真係神奇，功效同廣告講嘅一模一樣。幫我收細咗毛孔，真正做到玻璃肌。的確有涼感，好似用薄荷嗰種咁，但唔會刺激。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: I’m really liking this product. It’s a lightweight gel-cream that I layer under thicker creams. I can’t speak to the pore tightening abilities just yet but I like it overall.
reviews.zh: 我真係幾鍾意呢款產品。佢係一款輕盈嘅 gel-cream，我會喺佢上面再疊一層厚身嘅面霜。毛孔收緊方面暫時仲未見到效果，但整體我都幾滿意。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: I was really excited to try Beplain’s mung bean pore line but I don’t like the smell it’s so unpleasant. This also made my face greasy so if I try using this again I just wouldn’t use too much product next time.
reviews.zh: 本來好期待試 Beplain 嘅綠豆毛孔系列，但我真係唔鍾意個味道，實在太難聞。仲有，用完塊面變得好油笠，所以如果再用嘅話，下次就唔會搽太多。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: I’ve been using this for a while now and I’m honestly impressed! It feels gentle on the skin and delivers noticeable results. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗一段時間，真心覺得好滿意！上皮膚感覺溫和，而且效果顯而易見。絕對成為我護膚程序入面嘅新寵兒。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: This has become a big step in my skin prepping before makeup. It has a cooling effect and I can tell my pores are much smaller, helping my makeup go on smoother. Not sticky and absorbs into your skin pretty quickly so you dont have to wait so long to start your makeup.
reviews.zh: 妝前護膚步驟入面，佢已經成為不可或缺嘅一步。有涼感，而且我可以感覺到毛孔細咗好多，之後上妝都更加貼服。唔會黏笠，而且好快就吸收到皮膚，所以唔使等好耐就可以開始化妝。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream 60ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: The beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight Up Soothing Cream feels so refreshing and lightweight on the skin. I love its smooth texture, and it absorbs well without leaving any heaviness. It helps my skin feel calm and balanced, especially during hot weather. The packaging is simple and easy to use, perfect for daily skincare. Very happy with this product!
reviews.zh: beplain 綠豆毛孔緊緻舒緩霜用喺皮膚上感覺好清爽、輕盈。我好鍾意佢滑溜嘅質地，吸收得好之餘又唔會有厚重感。尤其係天氣熱嘅時候，幫到我塊面保持平靜同水油平衡。包裝簡潔易用，啱晒日常護膚。對呢款產品非常滿意！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
